universe_note: Chain-level screen (method §6): universe built per LINK across all 11 links, worked in priority order — money corner (global-hydro-spillover) first, then the CHOKE_POINT (yajiang-developer), then by impact. Every row carries the link_id that surfaced it and a money_corner flag. TWO LINKS CONTRIBUTE NO ROWS AND THAT IS A FINDING, NOT AN OMISSION: yajiang-developer is the choke point with impact 95 and is UNINVESTABLE (a state-owned project vehicle with no listed line), and power-offtake is policy-assured demand with no separable listed expression. The chain's single most impactful link is therefore un-buyable, which is the central fact this screen surfaces. NO EDGAR FULL-TEXT SEARCH WAS RUN: 16 of 20 names are Chinese A/H, Indian or Austrian listings with no SEC filings, so supplier-side EDGAR discovery is structurally blind here, exactly as the chain's map_limitation states. The universe is therefore chain-research only, and no name was added by disclosure. NO EARNINGS NUGGETS ARE RECORDED: data/edgar/docs/ holds no document for any name here, and the verbatim rule fails closed rather than quoting unverifiable text. Every theme_revenue_exposure is null with basis, never estimated. GEV is the only name with market data on disk; the other 19 are PENDING_DATA with request rows queued this run. AMENDED 2026-09-02 into campaign-v1: the universe is now built from the COMPLETE O1/O2 profiles that exist against this chain's mapping (data/mappings/tibet-mega-dam.json, status COMPLETE, audit PASS), worked money-corner first. MONEY-CORNER LINK global-hydro-spillover WAS SEARCHED AND IS EMPTY: all 10 ACTIVE placements on it were checked against data/companies/, and none carries a COMPLETE profile scoped to this chain (9 BLOCKED at O3, 1 -- GE-VERNOVA -- COMPLETE but profiled only for ai-infrastructure with no tibet-mega-dam placement); see data_gaps and superseded_rows for the full basis. CHOKE_POINT link yajiang-developer remains empty as before: UNINVESTABLE, no listed line, no mapping placement. Of the chain's 11 links, only copper-conductors and riparian-risk-monitoring currently have any COMPLETE O2 profile at all (7 issuers total, all T1 US filers with dual-source prices and SEC companyfacts); the other 7 links with ACTIVE mapping placements (uhvdc-transmission, hydro-turbines, cement-materials, tunneling-tbm, civil-construction, global-hydro-spillover, india-counter-buildout) remain fully BLOCKED pending run profile --campaign coverage of their mostly-T3 non-US issuers. No EDGAR full-text search was run this pass: the 7 rows written are all US SEC filers already resolved via their mapping placement, so link-level FTS discovery was not needed to find them.
